# MaryMarii

> Printable activity pages for kids ages 3–8 (dot-to-dot, letter and number tracing, Christmas games) that come alive in augmented reality: a grown-up scans the QR code on the colored page with a normal phone camera and the child's own drawing moves on screen. No app, no account; nothing is uploaded. Instant PDF download (A4 + US Letter), print at home. Sold by MaryMariiArt (Blissena OÜ, Estonia).

Good gift for: parents, grandparents, teachers and homeschoolers looking for an inexpensive, screen-light hands-on activity, a Christmas Eve box filler or a stocking stuffer.

## How it works

1. Print a page and let the child connect the dots / trace and color it.
2. A grown-up scans the QR code on the page with the phone camera; the magic camera opens in the browser (iPhone and Android).
3. Point the phone at the page: the drawing comes alive in the child's own colors.

Also on Etsy: https://marymariiart.etsy.com · Contact: info@marymarii.com
